description: T-Mobile US, Inc., as America's supercharged Un-carrier, has disrupted the telecommunications industry by actively engaging with and listening to its customers and focusing on eliminating their pain points, and its customers benefit from what it believes is an unmatched combination of the best value and best network, alongside an unwavering focus on offering them the best possible service experience and an undisputable drive for disruptive innovation in wireless and beyond. This includes providing added value and what it believes is an exceptional experience while implementing signature Un-carrier initiatives that have changed the industry, such as ending annual service contracts, overages, unpredictable international roaming fees and data buckets, among other things, and it is inspired by a relentless focus on customer experience, consistently delivering award-winning customer experience, which drives customer satisfaction levels while enabling operational efficiencies. Utilizing its multilayer spectrum portfolio, its mission is to become Famous for Network and it has deployed low-band, mid-band and mmWave spectrum dedicated for 5G across its dense and broad network to create what it believes is America's largest, fastest, most awarded and most advanced 5G network, with substantially all of its revenues for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 earned in the United States, including Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
